segments.name: Pediatric health platform
segments.description: Provides FDA-cleared wearable pediatric monitors with video, sleep analytics, and subscription health insights for families.
segments.evidence: Owlet is a leading pediatric health platform and the only company globally to offer U.S. FDA-cleared and internationally medically-certified wearable pediatric monitors for home use.

revenueModel.text: Parents and caregivers purchase wearable monitors and video devices directly or through retailers; BabySat may be insurance-reimbursed; subscription services provide recurring revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Owlet products are marketed and distributed in the United States and internationally through consumer and, more recently, through healthcare distribution channels.

changes.text: In 2025, Dream Sock replaced the legacy Smart Sock product as the next-generation monitor.
changes.evidence: Dream Sock is the next-generation monitor that replaced our legacy Smart Sock product.
